Convert a metric window to the nearest odd pixel window

Source: R/field_extract.R
window_from_metres.Rd

A window expressed in pixels changes physical meaning with the ground sampling distance, so a quadrat-matched support has to be restated for every survey. This converts metres to the nearest odd pixel count for a given raster, and reports the metric support that count actually spans.

Usage

window_from_metres(reference, window_m)

Arguments

reference

A terra::SpatRaster whose resolution defines the conversion.

window_m

Desired support in metres (the side of the square).

Value

A list with window (odd pixel count), window_m_actual (what that count spans) and resolution.

Examples

r <- terra::rast(nrows = 100, ncols = 100, xmin = 0, xmax = 5.76, ymin = 0, ymax = 5.76)
window_from_metres(r, 0.52)
#> $window
#> [1] 9
#> 
#> $window_m_actual
#> [1] 0.5184
#> 
#> $resolution
#> [1] 0.0576
#>
